Acceptance criterion: Chat and saved tasks execute the same scenario through one controller with equivalent outcomes.
A normal model stop cannot mark an unfinished goal complete; blockers and approvals remain resumable.
Research survives failure before any write or approval card exists.
Concurrent UI/worker resume admits one owner and rejects old-generation effects.
Creating a new document never requires a preexisting document ID; an edit uses evidenced target identity.
Honest questions pass; unsupported completion claims fail; accepted and verified are distinct.
After restart the last completed research result is available without rerunning its effect.
An existing pending approval can be resumed or safely held without modifying its reviewed arguments.

Capability: Typed errors across gateway and app
Acceptance criterion: Reasoning exhaustion, outage, credits, format and context failures remain distinguishable end to end.
A model is marked tool-ready only after a validated multi-turn tool round trip for its route.
The captured reasoning-only length case enters bounded recovery under the actual model and spending limits.
Provider-required replay state survives a tool turn without appearing as answer text or exported reasoning.
Fragmented calls, empty endings, refusals and application errors yield correct typed outcomes.

Current baseline: Reference code exists; inactive in reports
Acceptance criterion: The catalog advertises only probes that passed; native calls reach Android without bypassing signed usage or policy.
Schema, account, call/result pairing and provider follow-up remain valid through approval and restart.
No combination of retry layers exceeds the run budget or automatically replays an uncertain write.
Fallback preserves route/privacy/free-or-paid policy and stops when no eligible model remains.
Every attempt including summary/finalization is attributed and admitted against bounded run limits.
A test adapter can add a connection without changing either UI or runtime control flow.
Changed schemas or coercions cannot inherit an old approval or corrupt exact resource IDs.
Wrong owner or changed credentials reject execution before dispatch on every entry path.
Approved account/tool/version/arguments remain identical at submission and after resume.
Crash at every submission boundary preserves accepted/unknown truth and never creates an automatic duplicate.
Every result matches exactly one invocation; duplicates and orphan results are rejected.
Independent reads can overlap while dependent work and mutations remain serialized and restart-safe.
An uncertain write offers check/reconcile controls; cancellation or model retry cannot resubmit it.
Large catalogs stay out of initial prompts and discovered schemas cannot expand permissions.
The original question, findings, source refs and remaining work survive a pre-approval model failure.
Equivalent failed reads and exhausted searches do not trigger repeated network work or endless model loops.
Timeout, HTTP refusal, policy denial and empty extraction retain different safe diagnostic codes.
Exhaustion preserves findings and offers continue or partial results without requesting missing account details.
Final descriptions cite supporting evidence and clearly distinguish snippets, fetched pages and unverified claims.

Current baseline: Body validation but no durable draft workflow
Acceptance criterion: A source-linked draft can be reviewed before any document creation is submitted.
Large resume contexts reach inference within model/payload limits while original details remain retrievable.
Estimate error is measured by route and corrections include tool schemas and output reserve.
Compaction cannot authorize an action, lose current intent or prevent access to permitted original observations.
Forget invalidates run snapshots, extraction, retrieval and old imports without silently erasing reconciliation truth.

Current baseline: Bounded file excerpts and OCR exist
Acceptance criterion: Long-file questions return cited relevant passages; exhaustive tasks disclose coverage and deletion removes indexes.
Local draft, accepted service object and verified published content are never conflated.
Rephrasing an honest clarification does not cause document-write nudges or canned failure substitution.
Continuation keeps goal/findings; answer-now cannot execute more tools or claim an unperformed write.
A new accepted instruction fences a stale answer and does not interrupt an already submitted effect incorrectly.
Tests distinguish user interruption, echo, model error, playback starvation and app backgrounding.
Unheard text and private reasoning never become spoken history; late callbacks cannot overwrite a newer turn.
Background/reboot/battery restrictions produce truthful pause/resume states on supported Android versions.
A scheduled run uses the same policies and resumes safely when questions, auth or approvals are needed.

Capability: Correlated event timeline and safe replay
Acceptance criterion: A report identifies root failure, completed effects, retry owner and next action without exposing credentials.
Both supplied failures and crash/ownership cases are reproduced synthetically; live claims require recorded live results.
An imported template declares capabilities and can be evaluated without granting accounts or execution authority.
A third party can add a safe tool/skill using documented versioned interfaces and test fixtures.
Supported remote MCP transport negotiates identity/auth/schema correctly; stdio support is host-specific.
Incompatible or revoked extensions cannot load stale authority; uninstall/disable has explicit data semantics.
Child runs return attributed results without inheriting private accounts or broader permissions; measured benefit justifies use.
Remote work is paired, capability-scoped, cancellable and reconciled independently of inference.
A transferred run has one current owner and cannot submit twice; sharing and encryption choices are explicit.
Shared/rented agents cannot inherit seller memory/accounts and only qualified versions receive capability badges.
Untrusted content, imported skills and cancelled callbacks cannot widen authority or restore forgotten sources.

Current baseline: User enters own Composio project key
Acceptance criterion: Any simpler onboarding preserves per-user credential ownership and never embeds a publisher-wide secret in the APK.

Capability: One workflow graph format and builder
Current baseline: Saved steps but no shared graph contract
Acceptance criterion: Imported graphs and the visual builder use the same runtime; per-node models and bounded quality loops do not create a second engine.

Capability: Versioned run and host SDK contracts
Acceptance criterion: A sample integration can start, inspect, pause and resume an authorized run through documented schemas and conformance fixtures.
Notifications and future messaging channels preserve recipient, conversation and permission scope and cannot silently publish elsewhere.
A read-only setup check distinguishes catalog, authentication, execution and agent-protocol readiness without a real write.
Exports omit secrets; imports cannot grant authority, revive forgotten content or automatically execute imported work.
Opt-in grants bind account/tool/resource/expiry/write limits and revocation; defaults and unrelated actions remain exact-review.
